name: pokemon-go-raid-roster-toolkit
description: Static Pokemon GO raid roster evaluator and raid boss team calculator.

scripts.check: node --check outputs/pokemon-raid-roster/app.js && node --check outputs/pokemon-raid-roster/manual-entry.js && node --check outputs/pokemon-raid-roster/raid-boss.js && node --check outputs/pokemon-raid-roster/config.js && node --check outputs/pokemon-raid-roster/config.example.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node work/test-pokemon-raid-roster.js && node work/test-manual-entry.js && node work/test-raid-boss-calculator.js
scripts.test:smoke: node work/playwright-smoke.js && node work/manual-entry-smoke.js && node work/raid-boss-smoke.js
